name: Philistia
startIntroPart1: Greetings from King Iamani of Ashdod. We Philistines originated from Greek migrant groups of the Aegean civilization. From roughly 1200 BC onwards, we settled in the area and gradually intermixed with the indigenous Canaanite population. Our confederation stretched along the Canaanite coast from Arish in the Sinai Peninsula to the Yarkon River running through Tel Aviv, and as far inland as Ekron and Gath.
startIntroPart2: Can you spread our presence far outside of our pentapolis?
declaringWar: We will bring you to your knees!
attacked: You have awakened the Goliath and now you will die!
defeated: We have been bested in a fair fight.
tradeRequest: We welcome trade that can enhance our empire.
uniques: Gain control over [8] tiles [in this city] <upon founding a city>
